featured_reviews.name: Momo Explorer
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved my visit to Asiana by Chef Sushrut in Kandivali!
Amazing variety with 70+ types of momos, all super juicy and flavourful. The ramen bowls were comforting and delicious — each one tasted unique. Also tried the Korean sizzler and sriracha wings, which were spot on.
Cozy ambience, hygienic setup, and authentic Pan-Asian flavours.
A must-visit for momo and Asian food lovers!

featured_reviews.name: Mumbai Food Craving
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Asiana by Chef Sushrut in Mahavir Nagar and honestly loved the experience. The place has beautiful Tibetan–Himalayan aesthetics with super chill vibes, perfect for a relaxed meal.

Tried their ramen bowls and they were comforting, flavourful and well portioned. What really stood out was the momo selection — they have 70+ varieties, which is insane. Also, the ongoing offer where you get a full plate of momos for just ₹1 on a ₹250 bill is unbelievable and totally worth it.

Big respect to Chef Sushrut for bringing ramen to the area and doing it so well. Great food, good pricing and warm service.
Definitely coming back again!

featured_reviews.name: Amit Madali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried the Cheese Chilli Fried Momos and they were amazing! Super crispy on the outside with a spicy, cheesy filling that’s full of flavor and cheese. The mild chilli flavour had the perfect kick without overpowering the taste.

The ambience was cool and laid-back — great for casual hangouts or quick bites. Loved the decor and the music added a nice touch.

They also have a nice variety of dishes on the menu, with good vegetarian and non-veg options.

Service was excellent — friendly staff, quick to serve.

Definitely recommend if you’re a momo lover

featured_reviews.name: ROHIT BANE
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a really great experience at Asiana by Chef Shurut. The overall atmosphere is warm, cozy, and perfect for a relaxed dining experience. The wooden table setup and neat presentation give a premium yet comfortable vibe. The table dining service was smooth and attentive — staff were polite, quick, and made sure everything was served properly.

I tried the Paneer Peri Peri Momos, and they were absolutely amazing! The momos were soft, perfectly steamed, and filled generously. The peri peri flavor was balanced — spicy, tangy, and super tasty. The chutneys served along with it made the experience even better, especially the spicy dip which complemented the momos perfectly.

Overall, a wonderful place for good food, good ambiance, and quality service. Definitely visiting again! ⭐️✨

By Rohit Bane
INSTA - @konnrohitt

featured_reviews.name: Sumit Padhiyar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this small Chinese shop, and I was truly impressed by the quality and taste of the food. It may be a small place, but the flavors are absolutely outstanding.

The standout dishes for me were the Paneer Noodles and the Fried Noodles. The Paneer Noodles were perfectly cooked, loaded with fresh vegetables, soft paneer pieces, and had the perfect balance of spices and sauces. Every bite was flavorful and satisfying. The Fried Noodles were equally delicious—crispy, fragrant, and packed with authentic Chinese taste that reminded me of street-style cooking at its best.

Despite being a small shop, the food quality was far better than many big restaurants. The portions were generous, the preparation was fresh, and the taste was unforgettable. It’s the kind of place where you can get real value for money and enjoy food that feels homemade yet restaurant-quality.

If you love Chinese food, especially noodles, this shop is definitely worth visiting. I will surely return and highly recommend it to anyone who wants great taste at a reasonable price.

featured_reviews.name: Prathamesh Bandivadekar
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited East Asia in Kandivali West and it instantly became one of my top favourites! The ambiance is warm, stylish and perfect for family dinners or weekends with friends. The menu is multi-cuisine and almost everything we tried was flavour-packed and fresh. Their unlimited lunch option is a total steal amazing variety and super satisfying! The pricing is surprisingly economical for the location and the quality they offer. They also serve alcohol, which definitely adds to the experience if you’re planning a chill evening. The staff is polite, service is quick and the overall vibe is just right. Whether you’re craving Asian, Indian, continental or just want a relaxed dining experience this place delivers every time. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Wanderer Ankita
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the finest restaurants in Kandivali to enjoy authentic and lip smacking asian, lebanese, continental & indian food.

It's a pure veg restaurant and most of the items available on their menu card are Jain. This place has a cute cafe also. Perfect for small parties, family lunch etc.

We tried the Vietnamese Summer Roll, crispy veggie cheung fun, truffle hummus, bruschetta bake n bite. All the dishes we ordered were too good.

We ended on a sweet note with the Innovation icecream sizzling chocolate brownie which literally melted in the mouth and was the perfect finale to our meal.

featured_reviews.name: Faisal Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited East Asia, Kandivali – a pure veg place serving absolutely mouth-watering Asian cuisine 🌏✨
The ambience is top-class, elegant yet cozy, perfect for a relaxed dine-in experience.
We started with their Wow Bao (Closed Bao) – soft, perfectly steamed and packed with flavour. The Korean Paneer was a total winner, crispy outside, tender inside, tossed in a deliciously balanced sauce.
For drinks, the Red Bull Mojito was refreshing with a fun twist, while the Peach Apricot Mocktail was light, fruity and super refreshing.
Mains didn’t disappoint at all. The Penne Pink Sauce was creamy and comforting, and the Nasi Goreng Rice had that perfect smoky flavour with well-balanced spices.
Ended the meal on a sweet note with their Strawberry Tres Leches – soft, milky and absolutely loved it 🍓❤️
Overall, East Asia Kandivali is a must-visit for pure veg Asian food lovers – great flavours, beautiful ambience and a satisfying experience all around.

featured_reviews.name: Chirag Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located in the bustling locality of Kandivali West, East Asia stands as a beacon for foodies who are looking for a diverse and delightful vegetarian dining experience. True to its name, the restaurant offers a vast selection of flavors from across East Asia, with a focus on fresh ingredients and an authentic approach to Asian cuisine. Whether you're a fan of Thai, or even Malaysian dishes or Indian , East Asia has something to please every palate.

Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)

Considering the quality of food, the portion sizes, and the variety, East Asia offers great value for money. It's reasonably priced, especially when compared to other multi-cuisine restaurants in the area. You’ll leave with a full stomach and a satisfied palate without breaking the bank

featured_reviews.name: Momo Explorer
featured_reviews.review_text: East Asia in Kandivali West is a gem! Loved the Veg Spicy Crunchy Sushi and the Dimsum Platter. The Whisky Flame Paneer is a must-try, and their soups are rich and comforting. The mains were filling and flavorful, and the sizzling brownie with ice cream was the perfect ending. Great food, great vibe—highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: mayur
featured_reviews.review_text:
First of all, a big 5 stars for the amazing singing performance by Prajwal Yadav. We genuinely loved listening to him - his old songs mashup brought back so many beautiful and sweet memories.

The ambience is lovely, the staff is friendly and welcoming, and the overall vibe is great. We enjoyed the Flaming Tibetan Spice Bowl, Cheesy Fries, Burnt Chilli Potato Bai, and Blue Lagoon mocktail; everything was nice except the Nasi Goreng, which was a bit too dark due to excess soy sauce compared to the pictures. Overall, we loved the place and will definitely visit again.

featured_reviews.name: Noor Sayeed Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
This restaurant provides a consistently satisfying dining experience with a menu that successfully spans multiple cuisines. The strength lies in its execution dishes are flavourful, fresh, and prepared with care.

We began with the Beijing Paneer, which was crisp and had a well-balanced, mild spice. The Spicy Cheese & Water Chestnut Dimsums were a notable highlight, featuring a thin wrapper and a generous, creamy filling that dumpling fans would appreciate.

Japchae noodles served were cooked perfectly. The Continental Sizzler was a substantial and well-composed main. The combination of Mexican rice, a distinct pink curry, pesto paneer, crispy fries, and sautéed vegetables was cohesive and filling. To drink, the Apple & Elderflower Spritz and Peach & Apricot Zing mocktails were refreshing and well-crafted.

The meal concluded smoothly with the Dulce Cheesecake, a dessert that was appropriately rich and had a pleasing, melt-in-the-mouth texture.

Beyond the food, the space itself sets the tone with beautiful boho-style decor, eye-catching wall art, and thoughtful details even the glasses are uniquely crafted. It’s the perfect, chill spot for a date night, a special celebration, or a relaxed meal with friends.. It's a solid choice for anyone seeking a wide variety of tasty food in a relaxed and visually appealing setting.

name: Yummy Kitchen
description:
Yummy Kitchen – The Best Chinese Restaurant in Charkop, Kandivali West
For over 18 years, Yummy Kitchen has been the go-to destination for food lovers craving authentic and delicious Chinese cuisine in Charkop, Kandivali West. Known for our rich flavors, fresh ingredients, and exceptional service, we have built a reputation as the best Chinese restaurant in the area. Due to building redevelopment, we have relocated but continue to serve the same delightful dishes that our loyal customers love. Whether you’re craving spicy Schezwan rice, crispy, flavorful Manchurian, or sizzling noodles, we’ve got you covered.
At Yummy Kitchen, we focus on takeaway and home delivery, ensuring that our signature flavors reach your doorstep fresh & Hot.

The sushi was good and can be tried if you’re looking for vegetarian options. However, the nasi goreng tasted more like Manchurian gravy rice, which we didn’t really enjoy.

Apart from the food, we didn’t like the behavior of the staff member assisting with seating, as he seemed stressed when customers arrived. Additionally, there were quite a few mosquitoes, and to manage this, they were using dhoop, which caused a noticeable smell while dining.

Overall, you can visit this place for their veg sushi, but the overall experience could be improved.

featured_reviews.name: Zidane Dcosta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Food :- The food overall is good, would give it a 6 out of 10. Good for a quick bite or a budget dinner. A number of dishes options.

Sitting :- Also the place is good but the outdoor sitting is pretty congested.

Service :- The service is not that great. Very slow service and the management is bad and unorganized.

Atmosphere :- A noisy atmosphere, not recommended for peaceful dinning, only recommended for group dinning.

featured_reviews.name: Vishal Rathod
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely disappointing experience. Ordered Paneer Triple Rice for ₹350, and shockingly, there was no paneer in the rice at all — only a few pieces floating in the gravy. Any decent Paneer Triple Rice has paneer in both rice and gravy. When I asked the Manager why, I was told, “We’ve been serving it like this for a long time.” That’s not an excuse — it’s just cutting corners. For the price charged, the quality unacceptable. Definitely not worth your money.

featured_reviews.name: Davidd T
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good restaurant, I have in Kandivali for more than 20+ years never visited this place, today made a point to try this place it didn't disappoint us.
The food was good I have not come across a dish crunchy veg, I have tried crispy veg in many restaurants but this crunchy veg was amazing recommend to try, thier thali , sada dosa, spring dosa even the tea was good.
Whenever anyone is around Charkop can try this veg restaurant.

featured_reviews.name: Gautam Dalal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Food taste was all the same, red, white and green gravy...

Quantity was served very poorly, pushing for a new dish order while serving... Then we learnt the main manager was serving, so much for the customer centricity.

Atmosphere is bad, honks all the time and super cramped seats.

Rates were higher than Golden Leaf, which is right opposite, yet far far better.

Avoidable Hotel

featured_reviews.name: Kiran Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text: Sometimes order idli and wada at Tulsi Vihar Charkop — they taste really good, and the dal khichdi is nice too. Service is decent and ambiance is comfortable. A good spot for a tasty veg breakfast.

featured_reviews.name: Pavitra Shettigar
featured_reviews.review_text: A great pure veg restaurant that truly delivers on taste and value! The food is delicious and reasonably priced, making it perfect for both casual meals and family outings. The service is quick and efficient, which adds to the overall experience. Their thali is absolutely amazing, wholesome, flavorful, and filling. And don’t miss their chaas.. it’s a must-try

featured_reviews.name: Ankit Kasare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tasteless Food, with Lame Service & Bad Atmosphere, everything worse. Wish could give less than 1 star.

Had Veg Kolhapuri with Butter Roti, Chapati & Tawa Pulav. Worst taste of these dishes I ever had, let's say tasteless. Hardened Chapatis, No masala or any other taste you expect from Gravy or Pulav. Was praying to god that we don't get hair or fly in the dishes which you get in such places. Staff barely interested in providing you apt service. Horrible Experience. Not worth your money.
